content.text: Lots of kids Milo's age still co-sleep, and it's very fixable. Start with a small first step tonight. Keep the same bedtime routine, then put Milo down in their own bed with you sitting on a chair beside it. Once they're settled, stay put and stay quiet. In a few nights, move the chair a bit closer to the door. Going gradually usually goes smoother than a sudden switch. A simple "when the clock says 7, you can come find me" style reward chart can help too.
